rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: Compac interference wave detected! The KLF squad is coming!
rows.display_text:
「Compac interference wave detected! The
KLF squad is coming!」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: T-that's a huge number!
rows.display_text: 「T-that's a huge number!」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Seems like we and the Vodarac have really gotten in their way.
rows.display_text:
「Seems like we and the Vodarac have
really gotten in their way.」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: I'm counting on you, Holland!
rows.display_text: 「I'm counting on you, Holland!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: You all know the stakes! If they break through us, the Vodarac are finished!
rows.display_text:
「You all know the stakes! If they break
through us, the Vodarac are finished!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Shoot them down before the military bastards can crash into Vodara Shrine!
rows.display_text:
「Shoot them down before the military
bastards can crash into Vodara Shrine!」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: This is rough, seriously! Guess we've gotta get serious!
rows.display_text:
「This is rough, seriously! Guess we've
gotta get serious!」

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: We're at an overwhelming numbers disadvantage, so even one little mistake could be irreversible.
rows.display_text:
「We're at an overwhelming numbers
disadvantage, so even one little mistake
could be irreversible.」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Renton...
rows.display_text: 「Renton...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: ...I don't want to fight...
rows.display_text: 「...I don't want to fight...」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Eh...

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: But right now, there's no choice but to do it...! Let's go, Eureka!
rows.display_text:
「But right now, there's no choice but to
do it...! Let's go, Eureka!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Okay...!
rows.display_text: 「Okay...!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Hold out for five minutes! Do that, and they'll give up!
rows.display_text:
「Hold out for five minutes! Do that, and
they'll give up!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Listen up, all of you! Don't you dare die!
rows.display_text:
「Listen up, all of you! Don't you dare
die!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Renton! I'm counting on you to look after Eureka!!
rows.display_text:
「Renton! I'm counting on you to look
after Eureka!!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Yes!
rows.display_text: 「Yes!」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: The KLF squad is falling back!
rows.display_text: 「The KLF squad is falling back!」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: Looks like they lost their nerve. Guess you could call it a win by sheer guts on our part?
rows.display_text:
「Looks like they lost their nerve. Guess
you could call it a win by sheer guts on
our part?」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: Enemy squad confirmed wiped out!
rows.display_text: 「Enemy squad confirmed wiped out!」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: A victory of our own guts and grit.
rows.display_text: 「A victory of our own guts and grit.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: We did it... we did it, Eureka!
rows.display_text: 「We did it... we did it, Eureka!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Yeah...! Yeah!
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...! Yeah!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: (The one meant to be Eureka's other half... It wasn't me...)
rows.display_text:
（(The one meant to be Eureka's other
half... It wasn't me...)）

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: (But that doesn't matter right now. What I need to do is protect those two... protect hope itself.)
rows.display_text:
（(But that doesn't matter right now.
What I need to do is protect those two...
protect hope itself.)）

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: ...Holland?
rows.display_text: 「...Holland?」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Take care of Eureka... I'm counting on you, Renton. From here on too.
rows.display_text:
「Take care of Eureka... I'm counting on
you, Renton. From here on too.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Are you gonna do it or not? Make up your mind.
rows.display_text:
「Are you gonna do it or not? Make up
your mind.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I'll do it...! Because... that's what I decided.
rows.display_text:
「I'll do it...! Because... that's what I
decided.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: I see...
rows.display_text: 「I see...」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: (I'll do it too... Because that's the fight I found for myself...)
rows.display_text:
（(I'll do it too... Because that's the
fight I found for myself...)）

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Damn it! They got through!!
rows.display_text: 「Damn it! They got through!!」

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: At this rate, Vodara Shrine is...!!
rows.display_text: 「At this rate, Vodara Shrine is...!!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Aah!
rows.display_text: 「Aah!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Damn it! Is this really our limit!?
rows.display_text: 「Damn it! Is this really our limit!?」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: The military's heading for Vodara Shrine, you say?
rows.display_text:
「The military's heading for Vodara
Shrine, you say?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Dewey probably means to blow away the eyesore that is the Vodarac, building and all.
rows.display_text:
「Dewey probably means to blow away the
eyesore that is the Vodarac, building and
all.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Tch... brute force, huh... same old tactics as ever.
rows.display_text:
「Tch... brute force, huh... same old
tactics as ever.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: (The military is trying to wipe out the Vodarac, who want to coexist with the Coralians...)
rows.display_text:
（(The military is trying to wipe out
the Vodarac, who want to coexist with
the Coralians...)）

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: (To the military, the Coralians must be humanity's enemy...)
rows.display_text:
（(To the military, the Coralians must
be humanity's enemy...)）

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: (But I want to believe... that there's a path where we can live alongside the Coralians... alongside Eureka.)
rows.display_text:
（(But I want to believe... that there's
a path where we can live alongside the
Coralians... alongside Eureka.)）

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: It's okay, Eureka. I will never give up.
rows.display_text: 「It's okay, Eureka. I will never give up.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: So, Eureka... you mustn't throw away hope either.
rows.display_text:
「So, Eureka... you mustn't throw away
hope either.」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: That look on your face... seems like you've made peace with it.
rows.display_text:
「That look on your face... seems like
you've made peace with it.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: I've got no intention of giving up either. Not on this world... not on anything.
rows.display_text:
「I've got no intention of giving up
either. Not on this world... not on
anything.」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: If the leader's made up his mind, then I've got nothing more to say.
rows.display_text:
「If the leader's made up his mind, then
I've got nothing more to say.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Of course, that goes for us too.
rows.display_text: 「Of course, that goes for us too.」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: Coming this far, I've made my peace with it. I'll see this through to the end too.
rows.display_text:
「Coming this far, I've made my peace
with it. I'll see this through to the end
too.」

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: That's the gist of it. Let's do everything we possibly can.
rows.display_text:
「That's the gist of it. Let's do
everything we possibly can.」

rows.speaker: Ken-Goh
rows.en: Give the orders, Holland. You're the leader of Gekkostate.
rows.display_text:
「Give the orders, Holland. You're the
leader of Gekkostate.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Yeah...!
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Everyone, get ready! We're protecting Vodara Shrine from the military with our own hands!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, get ready! We're protecting
Vodara Shrine from the military with our
own hands!」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: Roger!
rows.display_text: 「Roger!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Those guys mean to break through us and charge straight into Vodara Shrine.
rows.display_text:
「Those guys mean to break through us
and charge straight into Vodara Shrine.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Shoot down every last one of them that comes at us!
rows.display_text:
「Shoot down every last one of them that
comes at us!」
